objective: Enforce explicit opt-in for the Pink Pig personal IP, require Jovi's original assets when the IP is requested, and redo the Flash/watchdog candidate through the reviewed jianying-editor-skill Jianying draft workflow without a mascot.

observed_issue.root_cause: The previous Flash brief was corrected away from Modbus assets, but the replacement cards still embedded repository-created mascot vectors. The upstream ian-fenzhu-illustrations repository is a style/prompt specification, not Jovi's original asset pack.
observed_issue.user_rule: Pink Pig is optional per video; when requested, use only Jovi's original personal-IP assets; never invent or substitute a pig.
observed_issue.delivery_rule: Jovi video production uses jianying-editor-skill as the selected Jianying editing backend; automatic export and desktop automation remain disabled.

prohibited_changes: automatic Jianying UI export or mouse/keyboard automation
remote Provider calls, model downloads, or source-audio reuse
automatic publication, Feishu, Cron, or Phase 1 promotion
acceptance: Mascot mode defaults to off and a brief without explicit user opt-in renders without Pink Pig assets or signature composition.
Explicit Pink Pig mode fails closed unless a verified user-owned original asset context is supplied; local self-created vectors, local raster placeholders, and upstream samples are rejected.
Flash/watchdog plain assets contain no mascot image references and are selected instead of Modbus assets for the no-mascot fixture.
A new Jianying draft is created using the reviewed jianying-editor-skill adapter with a portrait visual track, local narration, and aligned subtitles.
Existing drafts and the previous deterministic candidate remain untouched; automatic export remains disabled.
Targeted and full regressions pass, Obsidian and Codex project memory record the policy and evidence, and the branch is pushed with a verified remote SHA.
rollback: Revert only the commit created for this Change Request; do not delete or mutate existing Jianying drafts, prior deterministic candidates, user memory, or the external reference repository.
